timing: Written while supplement generation is running, before inspecting supplement aggregate outcomes. Original KV findings were known.
primary_posthoc_family: 5 groups x 2 contrasts (cross-self, interaction) x 2 deltas x 4 metrics (support_proxy, rougeL, displayed_text_z, content_tokens) = 80 intervals
bootstrap_unit: document; average the three matched generation-seed differences within each document before resampling; retain all conditions together
intervals: pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap for every metric; Bonferroni nominal familywise 95% intervals across the declared 80-comparison family
policy_comparison: random50 vs original evenly-spaced cross-half and both-half, paired on documents/seeds/delta, pointwise exploratory intervals
decoding_comparison: change in each cache effect (condition-full) between nucleus256 or topk50 and original nucleus128; paired difference-in-differences, pointwise exploratory intervals
retention_curve: all 100%,75%,50%,25% results and paired contrasts; no fitting or best-ratio selection
detection_threshold: calibrate only on the corresponding full-cache group's 200 unwatermarked validation documents per seed; apply that common threshold within the group; also report measured FPR. Use original full threshold for retention and random-policy groups.
memory: actual cache bytes at own final decoder step relative to full cache at the same step, not GPU peak-memory savings or controlled throughput; equal component retention is not equal total budget
limits: Same 500 independent test documents; seeds and decoding settings are repeated measures.
NLI scores remain automatic source-support proxies.
Random source policy has one fixed document-specific selection per document, not multiple independent policy seeds.
Intervals spanning zero do not prove equivalence, no effect or exact additivity.
No held-out independent-confirmation or universal cross-model claim.
